title: Decathlon Sports India's FY25 revenue (year to March 2025) was ₹4,133 crore (PTI, FPJ), about 3x Nike India's ~₹1,380 crore for the same year (Financial Express, 16 Feb 2026; Open, 10 Nov 2026: ₹1,381 crore); adidas India and Puma India each just over ₹3,000 crore (FE: adidas ₹3,114 cr, Puma ₹3,274 cr; Open: adidas ~₹3,259 cr FY25, Puma ~₹3,200 cr; years differ, so no exact figures on the card). Decathlon FY26: revenue from operations ₹4,478 crore (+8.35%), total income ₹4,517 crore, EBITDA ₹424 crore, net profit ₹63 crore after a ₹65 crore FY25 loss (Entrackr 5 Nov, Apparel Resources 5 Nov, Lapaas Voice, Open 10 Nov); Nike India has not reported FY26. 132 stores, about 200 planned by 2030 (Outlook Business, Open); about half the footwear sold in its Indian stores is made in India (Apparel Resources, Outlook Business, Open).
